title: Volunteer Program
content: Join the volunteer program at Sri Raghavendra Swamy Matha and serve the divine cause.

opportunities.description: Help in daily poojas, cleaning, and maintenance
Assist in serving food during Annadanam
Help in distributing prasada to devotees
Guide devotees and explain temple history
Help during festivals and special occasions

requirements: Should maintain decorum and follow temple rules
Must be willing to work in shifts
contact: Contact temple office for volunteer registration
